name: MultiTalk Promotional Video Scripter
description: Leverages the MultiTalk framework to generate dynamic, multi-agent conversational scripts for promotional videos. Creates engaging dialogues that showcase course value and answer potential student questions.
setup_instructions:
1. Clone the MultiTalk repository from GitHub.
2. Set up the Python environment and install dependencies.
3. Configure LLM API keys (e.g., OpenAI, Claude) for the conversational agents.
4. Define agent personas (e.g., 'Curious Student', 'Expert Instructor').
5. Create script generation templates based on course topics.
6. Integrate with a video generation API (e.g., Synthesia, HeyGen) to turn scripts into videos.
api_requirements: ["MeiGen-AI MultiTalk Framework","LLM API (e.g., OpenAI)","Video Synthesis API"]
engagement_tactics: ["Conversational marketing", "Problem-solution scripts", "Student success stories", "Explainer video dialogues"]
content_types: ["Promotional video scripts", "Conversational ad copy", "Explainer video content", "Student testimonial dialogues"]
